title: helianthus strumosus subsp. tomentosus
intro: Helianthus strumosus subsp. tomentosus, commonly known as woolly false sunflower, is a subspecies of the Helianthus strumosus plant, which is a type of flowering plant belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Helianthus strumosus subsp. tomentosus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
